titulo: GTA 6 File Size Revealed, And It’s Massive–See How It Compares To Other Huge Games
texto: Ahead of the game's release in November, GTA 6' s file size has been revealed, and it is massive. PlayStation Game Size reports that the $80 standard edition will take up 210GB of storage capacity. Size details for the $100 Ultimate Edition--which includes a ton of content not in the regular version--were not made available. We also don't know the Xbox Series X|S file size, but it's likely around the same. As announced previously, preloading for GTA 6 begins on November 12, which is good news considering the game is massive in terms of its file size. People will no doubt have to delete other content to fit the game on the PS5 or Xbox Series X|S. titulo: GTA 6 Online Could Be Released In Early 2027, Bank Says
texto: Take-Two's biggest release ever, GTA 6 , is coming up in November, but the company's share price continues to drop. It's down 21% this year and has now dipped under $200 this week after reaching a 52-week high of $265. In short, the stock is struggling , but one big bank says it sees a lot of upside, in part because Rockstar is expected to release a new version of GTA Online--potentially in the first quarter of 2027--that could generate loads of money. "We recommend being long $TTWO through the GTA 6 launch," the bank said in a memo to investors seen by Business Insider . Being "long" means the investor would buy and hold. The bank said Take-Two stock "remains cheap." In particular, Bank of America said investors are not fully appreciating how big GTA Online 2.0 could be. titulo: If GTA 6 Beats Football On Thanksgiving, That’s A Win, EA Founder Says
texto: Rockstar's GTA 6 is expected to be a giant success commercially, but just how big does the game need to be to actually be successful following a decade of development and perhaps one of the biggest development budgets ever ? We don't know, because Take-Two doesn't disclose that kind of information, but EA founder Bing Gordon has his own thoughts. On the Sozzi Unleashed show, Gordon said it would be "mind-blowing" if GTA 6 can reach 75 million copies sold. How did he arrive at that number? Gordon said he was basing this on a number--750 million--a figure he thought a previous GTA 6 trailer reached. If GTA 6 can sell 10% of that, or 75 million copies, that would be a success, he said. Gordon was referencing "the preview video," which might have been the GTA 6 Extended Look, which premiered on Netflix and then landed on YouTube. titulo: GTA 6 Reviews: Here’s When The Scores Might Come In
texto: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 releases on November 19, but when will you be able to read reviews? According to historical precedent and a new report, reviews for the open-world crime game should be available before launch. Insider Gaming reported that reviews for GTA 6 will be posted at some point before November 19, but the exact timing is unknown for now. According to insider NateTheHate , copies of the game were sent to reviewers already. He said people can start posting their reviews on November 18. The GTA 6 file size has been revealed as well, and as you might have guessed, it is a truly massive game. A scene from GTA 6. What history tells us The last GTA game, GTA 5, was released on September 17, 2013, and reviews for the game were published starting on September 16. titulo: Witchbrook Is Stardew Valley Meets Kiki’s Delivery Service, And It Finally Has A Release Date
texto: Eight years after its reveal, magical cozy game Witchbrook finally has a release date. We’ve been waiting a painfully long time for this Kiki’s Delivery Service-inspired pixel-art experience to break cover, and now we finally know it will be coming to PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2 on January 28, 2027. So you’ll have plenty of time to complete GTA 6 before diving into this severe tonal shift. At first glance, Witchbrook seems like yet another comfortable life sim along the same lines as Coral Island, Stardew Valley, Story of Seasons, and countless others. The genre is super popular, so developers need to do something incredibly impressive in order to stand out.
